description: Returns the lat/lon box for a neighborhood, street, or rough area such as downtown, with a suggested short incident query for get_city_crimes. get_area_trends accepts the place name directly.

days.description: Days covered by the suggested incident query. Defaults to 14 or 30 depending on the place.

place.description: Neighborhood, street, borough, or a rough area such as downtown or north side.

primary_types.description: Optional crime types to include in the suggested query.

name: resolve_place
title: Resolve a place
